name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code from PyPI through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run 'uvx --from grp-mcp-plugin==0.81.0rc33 grp-mcp-setup' once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc33): identical to grp-mcp. Changing a row in a large table no longer reports a failure that did not happen - the check that confirms a save was reading only the first 20 rows, so a change further down looked rejected when it had saved. Deleting a row could also be reported as successful purely because the row was not in the part of the table the tools could see. Past 1000 rows they now say they could not check, rather than guessing. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
